intro: If you want an in-town Buriram stay with fresh, clean rooms and an easy price — without gambling on a tired old hotel — SNOW HOUSE Buriram is a small newly-opened place whose name keeps coming up among the city's budget options. It sits in the Jiranakhon area, within walking distance of shops and restaurants, and about a 10-minute drive from Chang Arena. Guests like that the rooms look freshly opened, the TVs have Netflix, there's free morning coffee and free parking, from approx. THB 650/night.

body.html: The first thing SNOW HOUSE Buriram has going for it is how new it is. This small hotel opened fairly recently, so the building and rooms still look spotless. Several reviews say the same thing — the rooms look freshly opened, with everything still new and tidy, comfortable beds and clean bathrooms. For budget travellers who worry about ending up in a worn-out hotel, that freshness is an edge you don't often get at this price.

The location is in the Jiranakhon area of Nai Mueang, Mueang Buriram — right in town, within walking distance of shops, restaurants and convenience stores, unlike the near-stadium hotels that tend to sit away from the shops. Chang Arena is about 4 km away, roughly a 10-minute drive, and the Chang International Circuit is around 8 km. It suits visitors who'd rather stay in the city and drive out to the stadium on match day.
"The room is so clean and new, like it just opened. Staff are lovely, and at this price in town it's a real bargain — they even give you morning coffee."

Rooms come mainly as Standard, Deluxe Queen and Deluxe Twin. All have air conditioning, a flat-screen TV that supports Netflix, a fridge, a desk, a private bathroom with shower, and many have a balcony with a city view. There's free coffee or tea in the morning, a small touch guests like to mention. Free Wi-Fi and free parking on site make it convenient for those driving in — which is the main way most people reach Buriram.

To be straight about it, this is a small hotel of roughly 10–17 rooms. There's no swimming pool, no full restaurant and no gym — it's more a clean place to sleep in town than a resort to spend the whole day at. A guest or two have mentioned wishing the parking were a bit bigger. If you're after a property with full facilities, a pool and a big breakfast buffet, this isn't it — but if you just want a good, clean room in town at an easy price, it does the job well.

Because it's small and fairly new, the number of reviews is still modest (around 20 on Trip.com) compared with the larger hotels in town. But the feedback that exists points the same way: praise for cleanliness, newness and value. Breakfast is a light affair rather than a big buffet, so if you want a proper meal you can easily walk out to a place in town — which is one of the upsides of an in-town stay.

Overall, SNOW HOUSE Buriram is a sensible pick for budget travellers who want a fresh, clean room in town and aren't fussed about shared facilities. Its 8.7 score from 20 reviews reflects guests who are happy with the value and cleanliness. Prices start at around THB 650/night for a standard room and rise on big match days or race weekends at the Chang circuit, so book ahead — there aren't many rooms.

faq.q: Where is SNOW HOUSE Buriram, and how far is Chang Arena?
faq.a: It's at 527/99 Jiranakhon Soi 4, Nai Mueang, Mueang Buriram, right in town. Chang Arena is about 4 km away, roughly a 10-minute drive, and the Chang International Circuit is around 8 km. Being central, it's easy to walk to shops and restaurants.

faq.q: How much does SNOW HOUSE Buriram cost, and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Prices start at around THB 650/night for a Standard Room. There are also Deluxe Queen and Deluxe Twin options. Rates rise on big match days or race weekends at the Chang circuit, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Who is SNOW HOUSE Buriram best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for budget travellers who want a fresh, clean room in the city centre and people driving in who don't need a pool or hotel restaurant. If you want walking distance to Chang Arena or full facilities, there may be better options.

faq.q: Does SNOW HOUSE Buriram have free parking and Wi-Fi?
faq.a: Yes to both — the hotel has free parking and free Wi-Fi. In-room TVs support Netflix, and there's free coffee or tea in the morning. A guest or two have wished the parking were bigger, but overall it's convenient for self-drivers.

faq.q: Anything to watch out for before booking SNOW HOUSE Buriram?
faq.a: It's a small, newly-opened hotel of roughly 10–17 rooms with no pool or full restaurant and still a modest number of reviews, and it's about 4 km from Chang Arena, so you'll drive to the stadium. With few rooms it fills fast on big match days, so book ahead — but overall it's good value for rooms that are new and clean.
